defaults.$comment: Precambrian-Cambrian by default: it is the only boundary whose calibration reaches the whole geologic column, and it is the configuration the package's own run config and the paper's headline result use. Pinning the Flood to a younger boundary caps the oldest apparent age the model can produce, which is correct but makes the column chart open half empty.
